title: 14 · Removing a middle Node
objective: Use previous/current to bypass the Node being removed.
instructions: remove(head, key) returns head after removing the mapping.
Handle a null head, key at the head, in the middle, at the end, and not found.
hints: To remove a middle Node, the previous Node must point to current.next.
When the key is at head, replace head instead of using a null previous.
